baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct 'the sky, possessor of the buruj' joins the sky at word 1 to buruj at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: An overhead covering is internally articulated by celestial mansions or stations. The second noun therefore gives the elevated field an ordered topology rather than merely adding bright objects to it.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky or covering supplies the elevated field that the buruj can articulate.
Celestial mansions and stations divide the upper field into an ordered set of distinguishable positions.

changed_reading.before: A generic oath by a sky containing stars.
changed_reading.after: An oath by an elevated covering made structurally legible through an ordered array of celestial stations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The height image in al-sama and the fortified-tower image in al-buruj meet inside one possessive construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation bears distributed strongpoints. The sky can consequently be imagined as a high perimeter or protected architecture, while the celestial-station reading remains available alongside it.

activation_trace.role: Rising and elevation place the whole construction above the reader.
Fortified towers and palaces turn elevated plurality into a defended architectural perimeter.

changed_reading.before: The sky is open astronomical space.
changed_reading.after: The sky is also a high, distributed fortification whose prominent stations function like strongpoints.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the focus root س م و activates visible marking, while buruj itself supplies a patterned-surface branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper covering can be read as a surface bearing identifying motifs. This does not replace 'sky' or 'buruj'; it adds a legibility model in which the plural features are marks arranged across a cover.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the sky's features readable as distinctions rather than anonymous lights.
The overhead covering provides the material-like surface on which those distinctions can appear.
A garment patterned with tower-like designs supplies the model of repeated motifs distributed over a surface.

changed_reading.before: Buruj are only objects located in the sky.
changed_reading.after: Buruj can coexist as a patterned system of visible identifying marks borne by the sky.

context_deltas.mechanism: The celestial stations become a temporal instrument: their ordered succession can measure duration, count toward an appointment, and locate the promised event. The sky is therefore not only spatially ordered but schedule-bearing.

activation_trace.role: Celestial stations supply the repeatable positions from which a calendar-like sequence can be inferred.
A duration of time turns the neighboring oath object into a temporal horizon rather than a bare date label.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the celestial sequence a terminus toward which it can point.
The non-dominant counting image sharpens the stations into countable indices of the appointment.

structural_cues: The first two oath objects place the buruj-bearing sky immediately beside a promised day.
Both objects are definite, bounded wholes, encouraging transfer from spatial ordering to temporal ordering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies celestial stations, duration, a bounded appointment, and a split-root counting image; I supply the arrow that station succession indexes the appointment. They may instead remain parallel oath objects without an operative calendar relation.

changed_reading.before: The sky has a static arrangement of celestial mansions.
changed_reading.after: The sky's mansions form a moving or countable schedule that makes the promised day locatable in cosmic time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible marks, an eye-like buruj branch, and the repeated witness vocabulary combine into an evidentiary geometry. The sky can be both a field exposed to sight and an array through which events become signs, without requiring that the sky itself be the grammatical witness.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation makes the upper field capable of carrying evidence.
The wide clear eye image contributes an optical geometry of breadth, contrast, and attentive seeing.
Presence with direct seeing connects the paired witness and witnessed to an observable field.
A sign that itself bears witness turns the perpetrators' watching into evidence against them.
Testimony grounded in knowledge completes the movement from visible sign to authoritative evidence.

structural_cues: The active-passive pair 'witness and witnessed' is later redistributed among human spectators and the universal witness.
The focus plural supplies multiple sight points rather than one undifferentiated backdrop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observable marks, an eye image, presence with seeing, and sign-bearing testimony; I infer that the buruj organize an evidentiary field. A live alternative is that all witnesses are separate beings or occasions and the sky remains only a parallel oath object.

changed_reading.before: The buruj are astronomical features admired or invoked.
changed_reading.after: The buruj also configure an observatory-like field in which seeing becomes durable testimony and spectators can become the observed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elevated fortified array is set against a deliberately cut, fuel-fed depth with watchers fixed at its edge. The two architectures reverse one another: towers rise and protect, while the trench descends and confines; the larger overhead order relativizes the perpetrators' local control.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering establishes the upper pole of the vertical contrast.
Fortified towers supply the protected high architecture opposed to the trench.
A long deep cleft supplies the engineered downward cut that inverts the focus ayah's rising structures.
Fire visible from afar makes the trench a grim lower beacon answering the prominent upper stations.
The hearth or fire-site image identifies the trench as constructed infrastructure, not accidental flame.
Sitting to watch or lie in wait fixes human observers at the rim of their coercive structure.

structural_cues: The construction 'dhat al-' recurs in 85:1 and 85:5, formally pairing the sky's buruj with the fire's fuel.
The sequence moves from height to cleft, then locates seated watchers above the cleft.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies height, fortification, a deep cut, a fire-site, and stationary watchers; I supply the counterarchitecture relation and the claim that the upper order judges the lower one. The two 'dhat' phrases could instead be formal parallels without moral or spatial inversion.

changed_reading.before: The fortified sky is a self-contained image of celestial grandeur.
changed_reading.after: The high buruj become the true counter-architecture over a counterfeit human enclosure built downward around fire and watched from its rim.

context_deltas.mechanism: A split-root mark in the focus, a cheek-brand branch from the trench root, fire used as a mark, and a witnessing sign produce a darker legibility model. Violence meant to mark bodies becomes the mark that identifies and exposes its agents within the sky's larger patterned field.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the focus-side logic by which traces disclose identity.
A patterned garment supplies the distributed surface on which multiple marks can be read together.
The cheek-brand image brings bodily marking into latent contact with the named trench.
Kindled fire and marking by fire make the persecutors' instrument a trace-producing device.
The witnessing sign converts a produced trace into evidence rather than mute injury.

structural_cues: Fire, bodies, and self-witnessing perpetrators occur in one compact scene.
The focus construction already makes a surface possess a plurality of conspicuous features.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several independent mark images and explicit witnessing; I infer that the attempted bodily mark rebounds as an identifying evidentiary mark on the agents. The live alternative is that the mark branches are only lexical echoes with no causal reversal.

changed_reading.before: The sky's pattern is decorative or astronomical.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the patterned sky is a counter-marking field where fire-made traces expose the makers of violence rather than erase the victims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The buruj cease to look like autonomous heavenly powers. Fortified multiplicity is held inside one dominion, one complete scope, and one witnessing knowledge, so every apparent strongpoint is subordinate to an encompassing sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Fortified towers supply the multiple strongpoints whose ownership and rank are being revised.
Dominance and overcoming prevent the towers from functioning as rival centers of power.
Sovereignty places the heavens and their strongpoints within a single governing possession.
Wholeness as complete enclosure extends the governing scope without gaps.
Presence with seeing makes the sovereign architecture fully observed from within its own domain.

structural_cues: The relative clause identifies the possessor of the heavens and earth, then closes with witness over every thing.
Plural buruj are grammatically possessed by one sky before the context names one encompassing dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortifications, dominance, sovereignty, totality, and witnessing presence; I infer a hierarchy in which the buruj are subordinate strongpoints. They may alternatively remain celestial ornaments within a dominion rather than administrative or defensive nodes.

changed_reading.before: The buruj are impressive celestial powers or fortresses in their own right.
changed_reading.after: They are distributed strongpoints inside one completely witnessed sovereignty, impressive precisely because they are possessed rather than independent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fire ordeal behaves like an assay that is supposed to test or alter its victims, but the focus ayah's readable signs reverse the diagnostic direction. What the scene finally reveals is the quality of the operators and the structure of their act.

activation_trace.role: A sign from which condition is discerned supplies the diagnostic surface for the reversal.
The clear contrasting eye image supplies the perceptual capacity to distinguish what the ordeal reveals.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism in which hidden quality is forced into view.
Burning and blackening supply the material process by which the persecutors attempt that test.
Scorching pain returns the material signature of the assay to those who imposed it.

structural_cues: The same ayah names the agents of fitna and assigns them a burning consequence.
The focus ayah precedes the scene with a field of conspicuous, differentiable features.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, burning, pain, and discernible signs; I supply the reversal that the ordeal diagnoses the operators rather than the victims. A live alternative is a direct trial-and-punishment sequence with no transfer of diagnostic target.

changed_reading.before: The sky's buruj are unrelated scenery before a persecution by fire.
changed_reading.after: The buruj become a larger diagnostic array under which the persecutors' furnace reveals and records the perpetrators' own quality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The upper covering's rain-and-vegetation scope joins a protected garden whose life runs through channels underneath. The vertical system is no longer only defensive or astronomical; it becomes hydrological architecture that answers the earlier trench with a life-bearing cut through the earth.

activation_trace.role: The overhead-cover branch includes cloud, rain, and rain-derived vegetation, supplying the upper source of a life-bearing system.
Fortified architecture contributes protection to the space sustained below.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies a protected living interior rather than an exposed enclosure.
Continuous flowing supplies movement through the lower level of the protected space.
The explicit underside fixes the flow within a two-level vertical arrangement.
A river cutting earth with running water transforms the earlier logic of a cut from lethal trench to sustaining channel.

structural_cues: The garden verse explicitly stacks garden above and rivers below.
This beneficial lower cut follows the surah's destructive trench, allowing a material reversal without merging the two destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rain-capable upper cover, protected garden, underside, flow, and earth-cutting river; I infer one vertical water architecture and contrast its channels with the trench. The garden and sky may instead be separate promised signs with no hydrological connection stated.

changed_reading.before: The sky's towers only defend or divide the upper realm.
changed_reading.after: The upper architecture can shelter and feed a vertical ecology whose lower cuts carry water, reversing the trench's use of depth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning paired with return turns the celestial stations from static coordinates into a recurrent circuit. Their order can hold both irreversible appointment and repeated passage, so calendrical and resurrection-like readings coexist rather than cancel one another.

activation_trace.role: Celestial stations provide the positions through which a returning circuit can repeatedly pass.
Beginning explicitly coupled with return supplies the first half of a repeatable cycle.
Return after departure and repetition after a start supplies the circuit's completing motion.

structural_cues: The two imperfect verbs are tightly paired in one clause.
Plural stations naturally permit serial departure from and return to positions, though that motion is reader-supplied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stations and an explicit begin-return pair; I infer recurring passage through those positions. The pair may refer solely to originating and restoring creatures, leaving the buruj spatial and static.

changed_reading.before: The celestial stations are fixed places counted toward one endpoint.
changed_reading.after: They also form a recurrent circuit in which beginning, disappearance, and return remain visibly ordered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The high fortification is absorbed into royal architecture. An elevated seat and raised canopy clarify the sky as a sovereign roof, while glory names the quality manifested through its towers rather than treating the towers as independent powers.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering supplies the roof-like field that can be re-seen as a canopy.
Towers and palaces supply the architectural members of the royal complex.
The elevated royal seat establishes sovereignty at the apex of the high architecture.
A raised roof or canopy directly bridges throne imagery to the sky as overhead cover.
Attained glory, generosity, and majesty supply the quality displayed by the architecture.

structural_cues: Both 85:1 and 85:15 use a possessor construction linking a bearer to a prominent architectural plurality or object.
The throne title follows claims of severe grasp, origination, return, forgiveness, and love, placing architecture inside agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead cover, towers, an elevated royal seat, a raised canopy, and majesty; I infer that these form one royal architectural model. The throne and sky can remain distinct possessions without a shared physical structure.

changed_reading.before: The sky resembles an impressive fortified perimeter.
changed_reading.after: It resembles a sovereign canopy or royal complex whose buruj display delegated majesty beneath a single elevated rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fortified celestial positions become a scale-setting map for reports of organized forces. Human hosts gather in mutual support and become renewed public accounts, while the focus places every such formation under a larger array of strongpoints.

activation_trace.role: Fortified towers supply strategic positions against which organized hosts can be spatially imagined.
News renewed in telling makes past formations present again within the reader's field.
Becoming a public account converts transient military power into an inspectable narrative object.
A mutually supporting host supplies the organized human formation placed beneath the larger array.

structural_cues: The rhetorical question explicitly asks whether the report of the hosts has arrived.
The focus plural and the later collective plural both invite comparison of distributed formations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortified positions, renewed report, public narration, and a supporting host; I infer that the opening sky scales and maps later military formations. The oath and the host stories may instead be independent demonstrations of power.

changed_reading.before: The celestial fortifications have no relation to human formations later in the surah.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they provide the larger strategic array within which every human host is positioned, diminished, and turned into report.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering truth, wearing a representation that belies reality, and putting something behind visibility appear to offer concealment. The encompassing perimeter reverses that logic: those who hide are themselves enclosed, so the fortified sky changes from possible refuge into a boundary with no exterior escape.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the largest apparent covering in the scene.
Fortified towers supply a perimeter that can change from shelter to inescapable boundary.
Covering and concealment supply the agents' attempted strategy against what is manifest.
A garment that misrepresents its wearer's condition supplies a false surface opposed to the focus ayah's readable pattern.
Putting a thing behind visibility intensifies the attempt to move truth outside the seen field.
Concrete surrounding turns the apparent shelter into an enclosure around the concealers.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody removes any epistemic gap as well as any spatial exit.

structural_cues: Denial is immediately followed by being encompassed from behind.
The opening sky covers from above, while the late enclosure reaches from the direction presumed hidden or rearward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, deceptive appearance, hiding behind visibility, and complete enclosure; I supply the reversal by which attempted concealment becomes containment. A live alternative is that disbelief and encompassing are stated morally without transforming the opening architecture.

changed_reading.before: The sky's fortified cover is a remote shelter-like image.
changed_reading.after: Its buruj form the visible edge of an all-sided enclosure: concealment beneath or behind a cover cannot place the denier outside the witnessing field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's marked and patterned upper surface is re-read through gathering, recitation, a broad writing board, and guarding. The buruj become analogous to a macro-inscription: discrete signs gathered into an ordered, preserved configuration. This is a formal correspondence, not an equation of sky and tablet.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation supplies the legible units of the upper configuration.
A surface patterned with tower-like designs supplies the visual syntax of repeated inscription-like motifs.
Gathering and joining explain how discrete signs become one coherent configuration.
Reading and recitation activate the configuration as something traversed in an ordered sequence.
Magnifying by mention links the preserved text's recited dignity to the sky's raised display.
A broad board used for writing or building supplies the inscription substrate and preserves the architectural resonance.
Guarding and watching over a thing stabilize the gathered pattern against loss or alteration.

structural_cues: The surah ends by moving from recited Quran to a preserved board.
The opening and closing both join a containing medium to distinguished content: sky with buruj, board with preserved recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies readable signs, a patterned surface, gathering, recitation, a writing-board, and guarding; I infer a macrotext analogy between the opening sky and closing preservation. The two media may instead remain separate signs with only compositional framing in common.

changed_reading.before: The buruj are physical objects or decorative patterns on an upper surface.
changed_reading.after: They also behave like guarded inscriptional units, gathered into a cosmic pattern that can be visually traversed as the recitation is audibly traversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because an anatomical eye is a branch image of buruj, not the ordinary lexical rendering of the plural. It remains anchored directly in focus word 3 and is activated by the later witness sequence; downstream prose should present it only as an optical analogy that coexists with celestial mansions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Buruj at word 3 carries the wide clear eye branch, while the elevated visible outline of al-sama at word 1 gives that eye-like field scale.

activation_trace.role: A raised outline visible from afar gives the optical field a conspicuous body.
The broad beautiful eye with clear white-black contrast supplies the outlier's literal optical image.
Presence with seeing activates the eye image as a witness-witnessed relation rather than mere anatomy.

changed_reading.before: The sky contains bright celestial mansions.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the sky opens like a vast clear eye whose differentiated buruj hold witness and witnessed within one field of sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the hunt sense of س م و and the bird-trap sense of ل و ح are not normal readings of 'sky' or 'board.' It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains a coherent watching mechanism from the seated ambush branch; downstream prose should label it speculative surveillance imagery, never translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky root carries a going-out-to-hunt branch, and buruj at word 3 carries elevated fortified positions suitable for a distributed watch.

activation_trace.role: Going out to hunt supplies pursuit and target-seeking as the outlier's initiating action.
Distributed fortified towers function as elevated blinds or surveillance points in the inferred grid.
Sitting in ambush or observation mirrors the human watchers and activates the hunting posture.
The owl used as a falcon trap introduces the reversal in which an apparent watcher or lure is itself caught.

changed_reading.before: The buruj are passive celestial locations above human spectators.
changed_reading.after: Speculatively, they form a hunting-surveillance grid in which those seated to watch victims discover that they occupy the watched and enclosed position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant rain-mark sense mapped from the sky root and on the patterned-garment branch of buruj. It stays anchored in both focus words and is materially activated by fertile earth, intertwined garden growth, and river-cut ground; downstream prose should frame it as an ecological resonance, not identify buruj with plants.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-sama at word 1 activates first rain that marks land with growth, while buruj at word 3 supplies repeated patterning across a covering.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies a seasonal process that writes visible life onto land.
The patterned garment supplies the repeated visual distribution into which seasonal growth can be organized.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receptive lower surface on which rain's marks emerge.
Intertwining and surging vegetation makes the seasonal mark dense enough to become a living cover.
A river cutting the earth with running water supplies the durable channels that sustain the pattern.

changed_reading.before: The sky's pattern is exclusively astronomical and remote from the earth.
changed_reading.after: As an ecological resonance, the buruj-bearing sky is a seasonal marking system whose ordered upper pattern becomes visible below as watered, interlaced growth.

strongest_changes: The celestial stations became a countable calendar oriented toward the promised day, while recurrence preserved a second cyclical reading.
Witness vocabulary changed visible buruj into an evidentiary observatory where watchers can become the observed.
The trench and its fixed spectators inverted the high fortification into a moral counter-architecture of height versus engineered depth.
Covering, hiding-behind, and encompassing reversed the sky from possible shelter into an all-sided boundary around those attempting concealment.
The closing Quran, board, and preservation recast the marked sky as a guarded macro-inscription without equating sky and tablet.
summary.what_was_special: The split mappings of س م و were unusually productive: visible mark, discerning sign, seasonal rain-mark, and narrow-domain images opened legibility models that the ordinary sky sense alone would not produce. The repeated shifts between height and depth, watching and being watched, cover and enclosure, fire-cut trench and water-cut channel kept several causal readings alive at once.
remaining_uncertainties: The calendar, observatory, royal-canopy, and macro-inscription models may be compositional analogies rather than intended identifications.
Non-dominant split-root activations are packet-licensed but remain form-distant and should not displace the dominant sky sense.
The witness sequence does not grammatically identify the sky or buruj as the witness, so the evidentiary role is inferred.
The fire counter-mark, hunting grid, and seasonal growth pattern remain live outliers whose directional reversals are reader-supplied.
